reports.title: Men's Summer Outfits 2026
reports.topic: every outfit for men in 2026 summer
reports.summary: Community and style guides agree summer 2026 menswear is a small remixable capsule: linen/camp collar/knit polo, tailored shorts, warm muted colors, and loafers or espadrilles. MFA outfit checks celebrate knit polos and roast layered looks in July heat.

reports.title: How to Search for Papers for Thesis
reports.topic: How to search for papers for thesis
reports.summary: Community guidance this month favors a layered search stack: Google Scholar or Semantic Scholar for entry, discipline databases for rigor, citation maps (ResearchRabbit/Litmaps) from seed papers, Elicit for structured extraction, and Zotero for organization. AI tools speed discovery but every claim still needs PDF verification; volume without notes is the most-cited failure mode.

reports.title: Best powerlifting squat programs
reports.topic: best powerlifting program for barbell squats
reports.summary: Community consensus picks programs by experience level: GZCLP for beginner-to-intermediate barbell squat progression, Calgary Barbell for meet-style peaking, and Russian Squat / Nuckols templates for squat specialization. Smolov stays the high-risk overreach option.

reports.title: Custom front-end UI for vibe coding
reports.topic: how to create my own front-end user interface for vibe coding
reports.summary: Builders are mostly forking or self-hosting CloudCLI (siteboon/claudecodeui) rather than inventing a vibe-coding shell from zero. DIY paths converge on spawn-CLI + WebSocket + React, while smaller wins include custom Claude Code status lines and design-token rules so agent-built UI does not look like AI slop.
